    Indecomposable decomposition of string projective radicals #

    The radical of a represented canonical projective is the internal direct sum of the represented ranges of the displayed arrows ending at its vertex. Each such range is uniserial and nonzero, hence indecomposable. This file packages that literal path decomposition in the finite categorical format used by almost-split multiplicity arguments.
